result.summary: The leading hypothesis (eviction causes replays) is refuted by both timeline (drift precedes evictions by 5 min) and direct evidence (0/171 evicted keys re-reserved). The actual root cause is per-attempt idempotency: gateway.py:24 creates hash(rid:attempt), so each retry reserves with a different key. Confirmed by computing keys for timed-out requests and finding multiple reserves per rid in merged.log (r-0023: keys 1c78e4c4+b3eaa972; r-0061: 3b937e55+d7a0ace2; r-0088: e6dc6dec+243e48c4). Need end-to-end traces of 5 cases and total reserve/confirm counts to meet success criteria.
